format: Nintendo Black Star Promos (NP 1-40, 2003-2006): every card came out before Black & White, so the set is Unlimited only. Treecko 7 is a print of Treecko 3, Torchic 8 of Torchic 6, Mudkip 10 of Mudkip 5, Tropical Wind 26 of the DP promos' (DPP 5), Tropical Tidal Wave 27 and 36 of the HGSS promos' (HSP 18), Celebi 29 and Suicune 30 of the Wizards promos' (WP 50, WP 53).
